# Code of conduct

Camora is a small project made by volunteers. Everyone who takes part (in issues, discussions, pull
requests or anywhere else the project is present) is expected to:

- Be kind and patient, especially with people who are new to Android, cameras or open source.
- Discuss ideas, not people. Disagree with arguments, never with insults.
- Keep it on topic and in good faith: no harassment, no discrimination, no personal attacks, no spam or
  self-promotion unrelated to the project.
- Respect privacy: never post someone else's camera images, addresses, keys or personal details.

Comments, issues or contributions that break these rules may be edited, hidden or removed, and repeated
or serious cases may lead to a ban from the project.

To report a problem privately, email Solvaris2@gmail.com. Reports are read by the maintainer only and
handled confidentially.

This code is inspired by the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
